name: Fusion Desk
description:
All-in-one desktop panel: taskbar, start menu with 7 layouts, system monitor, clipboard history, media controls, clock, Caffeine timer and App Hub shortcuts. Optional app launcher, control centre, desktop organizer, battery menu and glass styles on the same taskbar.

Clipboard: the clipboard history reads the clipboard whenever its content changes and keeps the entries in memory and, unless you turn it off, in ~/.cache/fusion-desk/clipboard.json (entries marked secret by password managers are skipped). An optional Super+V shortcut (off by default) opens the history. Paste-on-select (sends Ctrl+V to the focused window through a virtual keyboard) is opt-in. Clipboard data is never sent anywhere.

App Hub: when the separate App Hub app is installed, the menus show its app updates through its app-hub command; without it, no App Hub entries appear.
